plugins.name: pathiel
plugins.description: AI trading agent for Hyperliquid: Claude trades perps with an exact stop and target on every order. 30 MCP tools: desk briefs for oil and metals, bracket orders, risk sizing (3x, 1% per trade, one position by default), account reads. Mainnet by default, testnet opt-in, read-only without a key. Free: no builder fee.

plugins.name: pathiel-research
plugins.description: The risk-gated research layer AI agents trade through: a free, read-only, keyless MCP server with 6 tools (research_brief, events, prediction_odds, fred_series, headlines, levels) for BRENTOIL, HYPE, BTC, ETH and SP500. Hyperliquid public candles, news/RSS, Polymarket/Kalshi odds, the scheduled-event calendar, and pathiel's own stored desk thesis. Never touches a key, an account or an order.
